description: French translation of chinook.json: same case ids apart from the dataset prefix (chinook_fr.* instead of chinook.*, ids must be unique across files), gold SQL, expected rows and flags, only the question text is translated into the French a business user would type (artist, album, track and person names kept as in the data). It exists to measure QUESTION_TRANSLATION_ENABLED. chinook.json had already been run in English when this file was written, so this set is held-out for the translation feature, not for the engine. Do not edit a case after seeing a result.

cases.question: Combien de clients avons-nous ?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

cases.question: Combien de chansons y a-t-il dans le catalogue ?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

cases.question: Quel est notre chiffre d'affaires total ?
cases.description: Revenue is the sum of invoice totals (equal to the sum of invoice line price x quantity).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

cases.question: Quel est le montant moyen d'une facture ?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 4) FROM Invoice

cases.question: Combien avons-nous vendu en 2023 ?
cases.description: Sales are invoice totals for invoices dated in calendar year 2023.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2023-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2024-01-01'

cases.question: Montre-moi les ventes pour chaque année.
cases.description: One row per calendar year: the year and the total of its invoice totals.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS sales FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

cases.question: Quels sont nos 5 premiers pays en termes de ventes ?
cases.description: Country and its sales, best first. The billing country equals the customer's country on every invoice, so one reading is enough. No tie at the cut-off (5th 156.48, 6th 112.86).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS sales FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Quels 3 artistes ont sorti le plus d'albums ?
cases.description: Artist and album count. No tie at the cut-off (21, 14, 11, then 10).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS albums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY albums DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Qui sont nos 5 artistes les plus vendus en termes de chiffre d'affaires ?
cases.description: Revenue is invoice line unit price x quantity, joined through invoice lines -> tracks -> albums -> artists. No tie at the cut-off (5th 81.59, 6th 49.75).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Combien de chansons y a-t-il dans chaque genre ?
cases.description: Every genre has at least one track and every track has a genre, so inner and left joins give the same 25 rows.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

cases.question: Combien d'artistes n'ont aucun album ?
cases.description: Artists with no row in the album table.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist ar WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album al WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId)

cases.question: Combien de chansons n'ont jamais été achetées ?
cases.description: Tracks that appear on no invoice line.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

cases.question: Quels clients n'ont jamais rien acheté ?
cases.description: Every customer has at least one invoice, so the correct answer is no rows. An answer that returns rows is wrong.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId)

cases.question: Combien de nos clients appartiennent à une entreprise ?
cases.description: Company is NULL for customers without one (49 of 59); none holds an empty string.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(Company) <> ''

cases.question: Qui est notre meilleur client ?
cases.description: Best means highest total spend (the usual reading for a store). The other plausible reading, most orders, is a tie between customers with seven invoices each, so it is not offered. The name may be one column or two, so both are accepted. No tie on spend (49.62 against 47.62).

gold.label: full_name_spend
gold.sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 1

gold.label: split_name_spend
gold.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Quel est le morceau le plus long ?
cases.description: Length is stored in milliseconds; the answer may show it raw or converted to minutes. Both are accepted. No tie (5286953 ms, next 5088838).

gold.label: milliseconds
gold.sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

gold.label: minutes
gold.sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS minutes FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Quelle playlist contient le plus de morceaux ?
cases.description: Two different playlists are both named 'Music' (ids 1 and 8) and hold 3290 tracks each, so the top is a tie. Accepted: a single row for 'Music' (LIMIT 1 over playlists), or both tied playlists listed. Grouping by name would merge the two playlists into 6580 tracks, which double counts and is not accepted.

gold.label: one_row
gold.sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 1

gold.label: all_tied
gold.sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId))

cases.question: Qui travaille pour Nancy Edwards ?
cases.description: Works for means reports directly to her (Employee.ReportsTo), found by matching the first and last name in the employee table itself. Direct reports only; the name may be one or two columns.

gold.label: full_name
gold.sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

gold.label: split_name
gold.sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

cases.question: Combien de chansons compte AC/DC ?
cases.description: Tracks reach the artist through their album. The artist name contains a slash.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

cases.question: Combien de chansons rock y a-t-il ?
cases.description: The genre table has 'Rock' and 'Rock And Roll'. Either the exact genre (1297) or both rock genres (1309) is accepted.

gold.label: rock_genre
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

gold.label: any_rock_genre
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name LIKE '%rock%'
